issues.display_title: Issue #1294: Bug Fix: API Error Responses Expose SQL Queries
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File: 2026-06-04-api-error-sanitization-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1 — Database errors show a friendly message, not SQL

Given the database is unreachable when a user performs any action (e.g. uploading a tour) When the app receives the error response Then the user sees "Service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later." — no SQL query, no database details, no error codes

AC-2 — Any other unexpected error also shows a friendly message

Given an unhandled server error occurs on any endpoint When the app receives the error response Then the user sees "Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again later." — no stack traces, no file paths, no internal details

AC-3 — Errors are still visible to the engineering team

Given a database or unexpected error occurs When the server handles it Then the full error details (including SQL, stack trace, file path) are written to the server logs — nothing is lost for debugging

AC-4 — Normal API responses are unchanged

Given a request that succeeds, or fails with a known business error (e.g. "not owner", "invalid token") When the app receives the response Then the response is identical to before this fix — no change to any existing message or status code
